[Title] Long Deck 160
[Title] 160 slides

[Title] Pitot-Static Systems (9)
[NarrativeText] Pitot measures total pressure
[NarrativeText] Static ports measure ambient pressure
[NarrativeText] Leak checks follow any disturbance of the lines

[Title] Lockout and Tagout (99)
[NarrativeText] Identify every energy source
[NarrativeText] Apply personal locks and tags
[NarrativeText] Verify zero energy before work

[Title] Insulation Resistance Testing (100)
[Title] Megger test at 500 V or 1000 V
[Title] Record temperature with the reading
[NarrativeText] Discharge the circuit after the test
[Title] 6 Module 6

[Title] Torque Wrench Use (102)
[NarrativeText] Select a wrench in the middle of its range
[NarrativeText] Never use as a breaker bar
[Title] Store at the lowest setting

[Title] Three-Phase Power (103)
[NarrativeText] Phases are 120 degrees apart
[NarrativeText] Line voltage is root three times phase voltage
[NarrativeText] Balanced loads leave no neutral current

[Title] Confined Space Entry (104)
[NarrativeText] Test the atmosphere before entry
[NarrativeText] Attendant remains outside at all times
[NarrativeText] Rescue plan is in place before entry
[NarrativeText] Permit expires at end of shift

[Title] Pitot-Static Systems (105)
[NarrativeText] Pitot measures total pressure
[NarrativeText] Static ports measure ambient pressure
[NarrativeText] Leak checks follow any disturbance of the lines

[Title] Relief Valve Setting (106)
[NarrativeText] Set below the weakest component rating
[NarrativeText] Verify with a calibrated gauge
[NarrativeText] Seal the adjustment after setting

[Title] Battery Maintenance (107)
[NarrativeText] Check electrolyte level on vented cells
[NarrativeText] Keep terminals clean and torqued
[NarrativeText] Never mix cell chemistries
[NarrativeText] Ventilate during charging

[Title] Hydraulic Accumulators (108)
[Title] Store energy as pressurised gas against fluid
[Title] Bladder, piston and diaphragm types
[NarrativeText] Pre-charge is checked with the system depressurised

[Title] Relief Valve Setting (10)
[NarrativeText] Set below the weakest component rating
[NarrativeText] Verify with a calibrated gauge
[NarrativeText] Seal the adjustment after setting

[Title] Bus Bar Protection (109)
[NarrativeText] Differential schemes compare current in and out
[NarrativeText] Zone boundaries follow the CT locations
[NarrativeText] Check CT polarity during commissioning

[Title] ARINC 429 Basics (110)
[Title] Unidirectional serial bus, one transmitter
